title: The replies a review-reply turn answers with
description: The structured answer `oneharness.review-reply.toml` validates every reply-drafting turn against, and the shape `onepipeline` reads out of `results[].structured` of the retained member report before it posts one reply per comment in that comment's own thread. Closed at every level, so a drafter that invented a field is re-prompted here, up to `schema_max_retries`, rather than having it silently dropped downstream. The engine holds the result to further rules this schema cannot state — every comment it named exactly once, an `answered` body linking a commit it supplied, a `declined` one linking none — and refuses a result that breaks them without posting anything.

comment.description: The id of the comment this reply answers, exactly as the `### <id>` heading under `## Comments` names it.

disposition.description: `answered` where the commits under `## Commits` answer the comment, `declined` where the change leaves it as it is.

body.description: The reply as posted, in Markdown. 500 characters is the engine's own limit on a reply body.
